title: S1 ba-brief boundary manifest (eliciting-banking-brief + deterministic render)
description: Boundary manifest for the S1 brief node (ba-research): the INDEX of the 3-level ref-chain pack (INDEX -> EPIC-* files -> STORY-* files). Permissive (additionalProperties:true) so the same artifact can also carry brief.json sections and the discovery/brief layer links. NOTE: the manifest exposes epics[] / story_files[]; some downstream stages historically read singular epic / stories from this node (pre-existing naming carry-over, tracked separately — not introduced by the S1 composite).

discovery_file.description: Link to the discovery layer artifact produced by s1-discovery.

layers.description: Four-layer pack map: discovery, brief, epics, stories (see tmp/runs/shoppilot/S1b-ba-brief/INDEX.json).
